g.title: G
g.text: 18 tables · tested on PostgreSQL 16 · area = election-type FILTER values (criteria) · MASTER / LONG_TERM tier on the dataset · voter and voter_turnout partitioned by dataset_id

Ends: bar = exactly one, bar+circle = zero or one, crow+bar = one or many, crow+circle = zero or many. Violet = snapshot (no FK). Red = sensitive. Actor FKs (created_by, granted_by, revoked_by, voided_by, marked_by...) are listed but not drawn.

g.title: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT
g.text: HMAC + pepper; not unique; null after use

g.title: USER_DEVICE
g.text: required for Customer users, null for AGENT
one ACTIVE + one PENDING per user

g.title: VOTER
g.text: part_no, booth_no, booth_name / booth_address en/mt, serial_no
v_* / vr_* names en/mt, voter_id, age, sex
district, rural_urban, tehsil, block, pincode, state
